retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast silhouette of a musician against a vast, textured blue sky at dawn or dusk.
excludeWhen: urban or indoor settings are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body silhouette of a man playing a saxophone, positioned on the left third of the frame. He stands on a dark, flat horizon line. The background is a expansive sky filled with horizontal, streaky clouds in shades of deep blue and white, with a faint sunburst breaking through at the bottom right horizon. The lighting is strictly back-lit, rendering the subject as a solid black shape with minimal detail on the instrument's metallic surface.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject silhouette anchored to the bottom-left horizon
Horizontal cloud patterns contrasting with vertical subject posture
Sunburst at horizon balancing the subject's weight
Typography floating in the upper-right negative space
coreInvariants: Solid black silhouette of the musician
Dominant blue and white sky palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Musician occupies the left vertical third, extending from the bottom horizon to the upper middle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, solid ground plane at the bottom of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the dark silhouette on the left, across the textured sky to the sunburst at the bottom right, then up to the typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space provided by the sky in the upper right and center.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm white and pale yellow (sunburst and text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black silhouette and the bright sky; low saturation in the blues to maintain a cool, serene mood.
paletteRestrictions: No vibrant warm colors except at the horizon
No mid-tone grays in the silhouette

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family using weight and size variations for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rule separating artist name from title

candidateDirections.reason: Classic serif look that matches the sophisticated jazz aesthetic.
Higher contrast for a more modern, sharp editorial feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle photograph of a man's silhouette playing a saxophone, standing on a dark flat field at dawn. The sky should be filled with horizontal blue and white clouds with a small sunburst on the right horizon.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of white serif text in the upper right corner, right-aligned, with a thin white line between the lines.

verificationChecks: Is the horizon line low in the frame?
Is the text right-aligned in the upper right?
Does the sky have a cool blue dominant tone?

adjustableVariables: Exact placement of the musician on the horizontal axis
mustRedesign: Avoid any facial details on the musician
Ensure the saxophone is clearly identifiable by its outline

mustAchieve: Balanced negative space in the sky

postGenerationChecks: Check for solid black ground plane
Ensure no lens flare obscures the silhouette
Confirm the presence of horizontal cloud streaks
recipe.reuseFormula: Silhouette of [Subject] + [Atmospheric Sky Color] + [Horizon Sunburst] + [Right-Aligned Serif Typography]
